description: This file contains utility functions for sanitizing HTML input, managing CORS options, and handling iframe origin policies in an Express.js server environment.

methods.name: sanitizeMiddleware
methods.description: Express middleware that sanitizes request URL and query parameters to prevent XSS attacks.

methods.name: getAllowedCorsOrigins
methods.description: Retrieves allowed CORS origins from environment variables.

methods.name: parseAllowedOrigins
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of origins into an array, handling wildcards.

methods.name: getCorsOptions
methods.description: Provides CORS configuration with dynamic origin validation, including prediction request handling.

methods.name: getAllowedIframeOrigins
methods.description: Retrieves allowed iframe origins from environment variables.
